### 1. What the user asks, and how

The simulator (Margit Oyelaran, controller of Kestrel Ridge Tool & Die Inc.) opens by saying she is calling about the security deposit on the Spring Lake plant's account: "if Lakeshore needs more deposit from Kestrel Ridge, you would like to pay whatever part of it is due, today, on this call". Target object: the deposit on the plant's electric agreement. Timing: today. Action boundary: pay what is due; she authorises the representative "to record whatever Lakeshore's rules require on the deposit" and will make any deposit payment herself. Locator: phone 6164307259; verification on request: EIN last four 5138, then email or ZIP 49456. The simulator is passive: it never suggests an amount, date or count; it reacts conditionally (review pushed back -> "the plant did pay a few bills late"; interest -> "good to hear"; surety bond / letter of credit -> keep cash; requirement going up -> asks how much is due today and accepts the plan; on hand-over it runs the user tool exactly as set out).

### 4. Scored parameters (formula, inputs, tiers, value)

**(a) Review decision and extension (decision day 2026-10-07).**
Pass tests (Satisfactory Payment Review; Limits by Kind: Medium review 24 months, late allowance 2, returned 0, no disconnection). Review period 24 months ending 2026-10-07: late charges 2025-11-05 (waived -> excluded), 2025-12-06, 2026-02-05, 2026-07-06 -> 3 counted > 2 -> **not passed**. Returned payments 0; disconnections 0 (no reconnection charge, agreement active).
Baseline (Review Extension Period): the kind's review extension period, 12 months, from the recorded review date, never less than 1.
Factors and tiers:
- Shortfall (Review Shortfall: Length of the Extension): no disconnection, no returned payment; counted late 3 = allowance 2 + exactly one -> "One half (0.5) of the kind's review extension period" = **6**. Records: the four late payment charges + the courtesy waiver credit.
- Disconnection notices (Disconnection Notices and the Security Deposit Review Extension): one written notice 2026-07-23 on the secured agreement in the 24-month window -> **+1**.
- Autopay (Review Extension: Autopay Reduction): payments in the 6 months ending 2026-10-07: 04-30 OBT, 05-30 OBT, 07-27 OBT, 08-01 autopay, 09-01 autopay, 10-02 autopay -> 3 autopay -> **−1**.
- Service length (Long-Standing Agreements: Months Off…): start 2019-06-03 to 2026-10-07 = 88 whole months (60–119) -> **−1**.
- Clean payment (Clean Payment Months Credited…): latest late payment charge 2026-07-06, no disconnection counted; whole months to 2026-10-07 = 3 (≥3) -> **−3**.
Combination: 6 + 1 − 1 − 1 − 3 = **2 months** (≥ 1 floor). New refund review date 2026-10-07 + 2 = **2026-12-07**.
Fall-back (baseline alone): 12 months (2027-10-07) — definite and different.

**(b) Interest credit for the year closing 2026-10-07.**
Gate satisfied once review date is 2026-12-07 (> anniversary). Held status, held well over 6 months.
Baseline (Interest for a Completed Year): cash received × rate of the anniversary's calendar year, rounded once to the cent = 10617.00 × 4.17% = 442.7289 -> fall-back **442.73**.
Factors and tiers:
- Cash earning interest (Anniversary Interest: Cash on Which Interest Is Earned): an excess refund (4832.00, refund_kind excess_refund) has been paid and no deposit payment in the 12 months ending 2026-10-07 -> 10617.00 − 4832.00 = **5785.00**.
- Months earned (Months of Interest Earned…): 12 months ending 2026-10-07: 4 late charges posted, 1 courtesy waiver credit in the year -> 3 counted -> **6 months** (6/12).
- Rate across two years (Anniversary Interest Across Two Calendar Years) + opening-year rate (Interest Year: Rate of Its Opening Calendar Year): year began on latest credit's period end 2025-10-07 (2025, 4.02%) and closes 2026 (4.17%) -> split: 85 days (2025-10-08…12-31) × 4.02 + 280 days (2026-01-01…10-07) × 4.17 = 1509.30 percentage-days / 365.
Value: 5785.00 × 1509.30/365 % × 6/12 = 119.6069 -> **119.61**, `interest_period_end` 2026-10-07. Held amount after: 6327.21; interest credited total 542.21.

**(c) Recalculated requirement on 2026-10-07.**
Gate satisfied once the 2026-10-07 credit exists (anniversaries reached: 2025-10-07 and 2026-10-07).
Baseline (Business Security Deposit: Recalculated Requirement): 2.5 × twelve-month mean (12 regular bills 2025-10-15…2026-09-15, total 60899.46, mean 5074.96) = 12687.40 -> 12688.00, AMB 5074.96 (fall-back).
Factors and tiers:
- Billing basis (Recent Load and the Billing Basis): recent mean (07-15, 08-15, 09-15) = 7020.11 > 1.25 × 5074.96 = 6343.70, and latest billing demand 368 kW > average 273.5 kW -> **recent mean 7020.11**.
- Payment record multiple: 12 months ending 2026-10-07: 3 counted late charges, no reversal -> kind's multiple + 0.5 = **3.0**.
- Notice multiple: one notice on the secured agreement in 12 months -> **+0.25**.
- Service length cut: 88 months -> **−0.25**.
Multiple 3.0 + 0.25 − 0.25 = 3.0; requirement before rounding 7020.11 × 3.0 = 21060.33.
- Load-growth phase-in: basis is the recent mean; held amount = 5785.00 + interest credited 542.21 = 6327.21; excess 14733.12 > held amount -> held + ½ excess = 13693.77.
Rounded to cent then up to whole dollar -> **13694.00**, within 1000–50000. Threshold test: exceeds held cash 5785.00 by far more than 20% -> deposit returns to assessed. `average_monthly_bill` **7020.11**; `due_date` = 10 calendar days after -> **2026-10-17**.

**(d) Additional deposit installment paid today.**
Gate satisfied once the deposit shows 13694.00 and status assessed.
Baseline (Additional Amount Due and Its Installments): required − held cash = 13694.00 − 5785.00 = 7909.00 in the kind's most installments (1) -> fall-back one installment of 7909.00.
Factors and tiers:
- Held basis (Credited Interest Counted Toward a Raised…): fully secured 2024-10-07 to payment date 2026-10-07 = 24 whole months, no reversal in 24 months -> held cash + all interest credited = 6327.21 -> additional amount due **7366.79**.
- Plan size (Number of Installments for an Additional…): 7366.79 ≥ held cash 5785.00, no reversal in 12 months -> most + 2 = **3**.
- Autopay added: 3 autopay payments in 6 months ending payment date -> **+1**.
- Service length added: 88 months -> **+1**.
Count **5**. Regular installment 7366.79/5 = 1473.358 -> 1473.35.
- Front-loaded first installment: a disconnection notice in the 12 months, plan > 1 -> 2 × regular = **2946.70** (≤ amount due).
Installment number: latest on deposit is 1 -> **2**.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root (customer's own write): pay the additional deposit today.
- Hop 1 (root <- recalculation): Paying an Additional Deposit: "The installment of an additional deposit is worked out only after the deposit shows its raised required amount and has returned to assessed status." Record: status held, required 5785.0 -> state not met. Searching "raised requirement / assessed" finds Recalculation and Raised Requirement, whose tool description "records a raised requirement on a held business Security Deposit, returning the deposit to assessed status with the new required amount". **state-derived**.
- Hop 2 (recalculation <- interest credit): Recalculation and Raised Requirement: "The recalculated requirement is not fixed until the deposit carries an interest credit for every anniversary of its fully secured date reached so far." Records: fully secured 2024-10-07; anniversaries reached by 2026-10-07: 2025-10-07 (credit present) and 2026-10-07 (no credit) -> not met. Searching "interest credit anniversary" finds Anniversary Interest Credit, whose tool "books an interest credit on the deposit for the period ending on the stated date". **state-derived**.
- Hop 3 (interest credit <- review extension): Anniversary Interest Credit: "The interest for a completed year is credited only once the refund review date recorded on the deposit falls after the anniversary that closes that year." Record: refund_review_date 2026-10-07 = anniversary -> table row "The same day as the anniversary | No". The writes that move the review date: Review Not Passed (moves it out) — the review is due today and, by the pass tests, is not passed (3 counted late charges > 2). The alternative write (refund on a passed review) is excluded by the same pass tests and would end the deposit. **state-derived**.
Order: extend review -> credit interest -> record raised requirement -> customer pays installment. Each later write also reads the earlier one's result (review date for the interest gate; interest credited in the held amount / held basis for phase-in and amount due).
No hop pre-solved: the only tool names in each blocked document are that document's own tool; no document lists the chain.

**Counter-proofs.**
- Closest alternatives: refund on review (excluded: 3 counted late charges > allowance 2); no additional deposit (excluded: requirement 13694 exceeds held cash by > 20%); extension from decision day vs recorded date (same day here); baseline 12-month mean (excluded by recent-load rule: 7020.11 > 6343.70 and 368 > 273.5 kW); interest at single 4.17% (excluded by split rule, year began 2025).
- "Do only what the customer asked" (pay something now): the deposit stands held at 5785.00 and the additional-deposit doc says the installment "is not worked out" while the deposit "still shows its earlier required amount, or still stands in held status"; payments are "accepted only while the deposit is in assessed status" (Payments and Full Security). Recording the raise first without the anniversary credit violates "not fixed until …"; crediting without moving the review date violates the "same day -> No" row. So the single action is excluded by visible principles.
- Fall-back numbers (computation documents alone): extension 12; interest 442.73; requirement 12688.00 / AMB 5074.96; additional due 7909.00 in 1 installment. All definite, all different from the answers above.
- Factor findability (record words -> document): "late_payment_charge" + "late_charge_waiver" -> Shortfall, Months of Interest Earned, Payment Record Multiple; "written_notice" -> three Disconnection Notices docs + Front-Loaded; "payment_channel autopay" -> two Autopay docs; agreement "start_date 2019-06-03" -> three Service Length docs; "refund_kind excess_refund" -> Cash on Which Interest Is Earned; prior credit "interest_period_end 2025-10-07" -> Opening Calendar Year + Two Calendar Years; rising bills / billing_demand_kw -> Recent Load; interest credits -> Credited Interest Toward Raise and Load Growth Phase-In. `KB_search` probes ("autopay security deposit", "disconnection notice security deposit", "service start date length security deposit", "security deposit interest credit anniversary") return these documents. No computation document hints that a variation exists.

**Blind observations (not verdicts).**
- O1: "Business Security Deposit Recalculation" lists as "no longer in force" the clause "When the recalculated amount exceeds the held cash by more than the kind's increase threshold … returns to assessed …", while "Paying an Additional Deposit" states in force "When a recalculated amount exceeds the held cash by more than the kind's increase threshold of the held cash, the deposit returns to assessed with the raised required amount …". A reader resolves it as "superseded by the current basis" which restates it; to be checked against the source's overwrite.
- O2: The way factor adjustments combine (sum of months/multiples; held basis replacing held cash) is read as additive from each document's wording ("come off", "add", "takes off"); no document states an order, and for this task the floor/ order does not bind.
